nodes.label: multi-runtime workflow
nodes.rationale: Verifies actor-ts boots and the core actor + cluster paths behave identically on Bun, Node and Deno. Pushes include main as well as develop: main moves only via the release merge, which is --no-ff rather than a PR, so without it the exact commit users install had no Node/Deno signal at all.

nodes.label: bun / bun-floor / node / deno smoke matrix
nodes.rationale: tests/smoke/run-cases.mjs discovers cases under tests/smoke/cases/*.mjs, so adding a case is dropping a file with no CI edit. Bun runs twice - latest and the engines floor 1.3.0 - so the claimed floor is exercised. Node runs the compiled dist/ deliberately, since that is the surface end-users consume; Bun and Deno load TS directly, so the build step is skipped for them. fail-fast: false so a Deno-only regression does not mask a Node-only one.

nodes.label: bun unit suite job
nodes.rationale: The full bun:test suite runs only under Bun (Bun.serve, better-sqlite3 native compile, fastify autoload are Bun-specific or Bun-tested-only). Mirrors test.yml's Bun job but without the README-badge side effect, which stays in test.yml as the canonical updater.

nodes.label: Install under Bun before Node/Deno setup
nodes.rationale: Installing with no Node on PATH, exactly like publish.yml, makes better-sqlite3's postinstall resolve a prebuilt binary for Bun's ABI instead of falling back to a node-gyp source build. No smoke case touches better-sqlite3, so the Bun-ABI binary is inert for the Node and Deno runs.
